technique_name: Describe the cultural implications of a two party political system.
description: A two party political system has both advantages and disadvantages. On the one hand, it can facilitate greater competition between parties and help to ensure that citizens’ voices are heard. On the other hand, it can lead to polarization and gridlock, as the two parties have difficulty negotiating on contentious issues.
